verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a plausible feature for a consumer Microsoft app, so this axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents only sign-in approvals, OTP codes, passkeys, Verified IDs, backup and password export. Nothing in it mentions an in-app AI assistant or any way to delegate tasks to one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
